messages.subject: JSS paper and blavaan 0.3-2 released
parts:
blavaan 0.3-2 has been released to coincide with publication of the blavaan paper in Journal of Statistical Software. The main user-visible change in 0.3-2 involves bug fixes for Stan, primarily dealing with missing data. Further details are here:

http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/version.html

The published blavaan paper is available here:

https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v085.i04


Ed
